question: 显示销售额最高的前 10 个客户
sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: 统计每个区域的月度销售额
sql:
SELECT r.region_name, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) AS monthly_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name, DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month, r.region_name;

question: 最近 7 天每天的订单数
sql:
SELECT DATE(order_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE('now', '-7 days')
GROUP BY DATE(order_date)
ORDER BY day;

question: 查询所有产品的库存和价格
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price, stock FROM products ORDER BY product_id;

question: 平均订单金额超过 500 元的客户
sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING AVG(o.total_amount) > 500
ORDER BY avg_order DESC;

question: 查询每个客户的总订单数和总金额
sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_amount
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: 按品类统计销售额占比
sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS category_sales,
       (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items)) AS pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY category_sales DESC;

question: 查询从未下过订单的客户
sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;
